projects.description: A modern portfolio website for Sonolux, combining clean web design with interactive visuals and a responsive user experience.
A cute pixel-art virtual pet built with Java and JavaFX, featuring interactive gameplay, custom UI components, and simple pet management.
A simple and playful productivity timer built with Java and JavaFX, designed to make focused work sessions a little more fun.
A classic Snake game built with Java, featuring a simple game loop, keyboard controls, collision detection, and score tracking.
An interactive audiovisual experiment exploring real-time graphics and shader-based animation.
A playful computer vision project that uses a webcam to track hand movements and turn gestures into digital drawings.
